preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes n in each test case must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must start with '! ' followed by two integers representing the hidden nodes.
The output must end with 'Correct' if the hidden nodes are guessed correctly.
The number of queries made must not exceed 14.
